# Dorrit Peltdale

Dorrit Peltdale is currently the Data Analytics Manager at Umbix Dynamics, an adaptive tutoring platform that personalizes learning pathways and tracks student mastery. Since joining in 2018, Dorrit has led the development of advanced teacher dashboard metrics and predictive student modeling algorithms that enhance instructional decision-making.

Before Umbix, Dorrit spent five years creating early proficiency trackers at EduMetrics Solutions, which are now adopted by over 50 K-12 districts nationwide. Her work on Project Beacon introduced real-time mastery insights that helped educators tailor lessons dynamically.

Dorrit specializes in translating complex student data into actionable insights, blending statistical rigor with user-centered design. She collaborates closely with product managers, curriculum specialists, and district procurement teams to align analytics with educational goals. Her methodical yet adaptable working style emphasizes prototyping and iterative feedback to refine models and dashboards.

Current employer: [[companies/umbix-dynamics]].
